급여를 시장 수준에 맞추기 위해 주는 인상분을 뜻합니다. 보상이나 승진이 아니라 시장을 바로잡는 조정으로 제시되지만, 결과적으로는 급여 인상입니다.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.gloss: 시장 기준에 맞추기 위해 지급하는 급여 인상.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.definition: Aumento concedido afim de alinhar o salário às condições do mercado, embora a empresa o apresente como mero ajuste e não como recompensa.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.gloss: Reajuste salarial apresentado como correção para acompanhar o mercado.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.definition: การเพิ่มค่าจ้างเพื่อให้สอดคล้องกับเงินเดือนและค่าจ้างในตลาด แม้ผู้จ่ายค่าจ้างจะเรียกว่าเป็นการปรับแก้ไข แต่ในทางปฏิบัติก็ถือเป็นการขึ้นค่าจ้าง
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.gloss: การปรับค่าจ้างให้สอดคล้องกับระดับตลาด

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.definition: Çalışanın ücretini piyasa düzeyine yaklaştırmak amacıyla yapılan ücret artışıdır. Şirketler bunu genellikle ödül veya zam yerine bir düzeltme olarak ifade eder.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.gloss: Ücreti piyasa düzeyine getirmek için yapılan ve düzeltme olarak sunulan zam.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.definition: Dalam konteks ketenagakerjaan, istilah iniозначает kenaikan gaji yang dijelaskan sebagai penyesuaian agar acero sesuai kondisi pasar, bukan sebagai penghargaan atau Bonus.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.gloss: Penyesuaian gaji yang disebut perusahaan sebagai koreksi terhadap kondisi pasar.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.text: The company called it a market correction, which is still a pay rise.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.translation: Perusahaan menyebut kenaikan gaji itu sebagai koreksi pasar, meskipun sebenarnya tetap merupakan kenaikan gaji.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.text: The company called it a market correction, which is still a pay rise.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.translation: Şirket buna piyasa düzeltmesi dedi, ancak sonuçta yine bir ücret artışıydı.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.text: The company called it a market correction, which is still a pay rise.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.translation: บริษัทเรียกการเพิ่มค่าจ้างครั้งนี้ว่าการปรับค่าจ้างตามตลาด ซึ่งยังถือเป็นการขึ้นเงินเดือนอยู่ดี

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.text: The company called it a market correction, which is still a pay rise.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.translation: A empresa chamou de correção de mercado, mas, na prática, foi um aumento salarial.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.text: The company called it a market correction, which is still a pay rise.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.translation: 회사는 이를 시장 조정이라고 불렀지만, 결국에는 급여 인상이었다.

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.text: The company called it a market correction, which is still a pay rise.
28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.translation: -<company>は-<market correction>と呼んだが、結局は-<pay rise>だ。

28f7d813a04b0795a81dbb37b28dee68dc5aa29e.text: The company called it a market correction, which is still a pay rise.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: A belief about a group that is applied to a person without looking at that person.
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: A belief about a group that is applied to a person without looking at that person.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: ある集団を特徴づける固定的な考えを、実際には確かめずに個人へ当てはめることである。
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: ある集団についての一般的考えを Critique個人にそのまま適用すること。

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: 어떤 집단의 모든 사람을 특징짓는다고 믿는 일반화된 생각이다. 실제 개인의 특성을 확인하지 않고 그 집단에 속한다는 이유만으로 적용한다는 점이 문제다.
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: 한 집단에 대한 신념을 개별인을 보지 않고 적용하는 고정관념.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: Uma ideia simplificada e generalizada sobre um grupo, atribuída a cada um de seus membros sem considerar suas características individuais.
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: Aplicar a uma pessoa uma crença geral sobre um grupo.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: Stereotipe merupakan generalisasi yang dianggap berlaku bagi semua anggota sebuah kelompok. Keyakinan tersebut dapat mendistorsi penilaian terhadap orang sebagai individu.
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: Keyakinan tentang suatu kelompok yang diterapkan kepada individu tanpa menilainya secara pribadi.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: ความเชื่อเกี่ยวกับกลุ่มหนึ่งที่นำไปใช้กับบุคคลโดยไม่พิจารณาตัวบุคคลนั้น อคติทั่วไปจึงอาจทำให้ตัดสินคนจากข้อมูลไม่เพียงพอ
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: ความเชื่อที่เหมารวมคนทั้งกลุ่มโดยไม่ดูความแตกต่างของแต่ละคน

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: Bir grup hakkındaki genellemenin, kişinin bireysel özellikleri incelenmeden ona uygulanması. Karşıdaki kişi hakkında kesinlikle doğru bilgi vermez.
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: Bir gruba ilişkin inancı, tek bir kişiye bakılmadan ona uygulama.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.translation: Erkekler ve kadınlar hakkında söylediği cümle bir kalıp yargıydı ve karşısındaki erkeğin özellikleri hakkında hiçbir şey söylemiyordu.
ประโยคเกี่ยวกับผู้ชายและผู้หญิงเป็นแบบคิดเหมารวมต่อกลุ่ม และไม่ได้บอกอะไรเกี่ยวกับผู้ชายที่อยู่ตรงหน้าเลย
Pernyataan tentangpria dan wanita itu merupakan stereotipe dan tidak menjelaskan apa pun tentang pria yang ada di depannya.
Dizer que todos os homens são iguais é um estereótipo e não diz nada sobre o homem à sua frente.
남성과 여성을 한 문장으로 단정하는 것은 고정관념일 뿐, 눈앞의 한 사람을 설명해 주지 않는다.
男性と女性についての発言は固定観念であり、目の前の男性について何も解決しない。

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.text: That sentence about men and women is a stereotype, and it settles nothing about the man in front of you.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.definition: A belief about a group that is applied to a person without looking at that person.
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.gloss: A belief about a group that is applied to a person without looking at that person.

28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.text: That was a stereotype, not an observation: nobody in the room had looked at the man in front of them.
28fcc4572ac6fdf602bb48dcf8770152081b93ff.translation: Đó là một khuôn mẫu, không phải một quan sát: không ai trong phòng nhìn người đàn ông đứng trước mặt họ.
